extName.description: Extension name shown in chrome://extensions and the Chrome Web Store listing title.

extDesc.message: Right-click any image for WCAG-friendly alt text. Private, no login, no API key, no cloud. Uses Chrome's built-in AI.
extDesc.description: Extension description shown in chrome://extensions and the Chrome Web Store listing short summary (≤132 chars).

actionTitle.description: Tooltip for the toolbar action icon.

permContextMenusJustification.message: Registers the right-click 'Generate alt text' menu on images. The user's click is the explicit gesture that authorizes single-image processing.
permContextMenusJustification.description: CWS reviewer justification for the contextMenus permission.

permActiveTabJustification.message: Granted on user gesture (right-click or badge click), authorizes the page audit. Does not require host_permissions.
permActiveTabJustification.description: CWS reviewer justification for the activeTab permission.

permScriptingJustification.message: Enables dynamic executeScript for the audit pass and to write generated alt text. No static content scripts.
permScriptingJustification.description: CWS reviewer justification for the scripting permission.

permSidePanelJustification.message: Opens the side panel where the on-device LanguageModel runs. Prompt API is unavailable in the service worker.
permSidePanelJustification.description: CWS reviewer justification for the sidePanel permission.

permStorageJustification.message: Persists user preferences (audit toggle, save-history toggle, prompt template). No image bytes or generated text stored by default.
permStorageJustification.description: CWS reviewer justification for the storage permission.
